gate.training_gate: Pending independent adapter CPU/CUDA correctness, replay, and resource smoke tests.
reasons: The only public branch predates the revised and accepted paper.
The published RwAM implementation is absent.
The frozen extraction and save/load paths contain unresolved references.
The public code has a hard-coded forecasting covariate slice incompatible with 5-channel OHLCV.
Paper and code disagree on representation width and optimizer settings.
These findings prohibit direct source reuse but are disclosed reconstruction evidence rather than blockers to an independently authored implementation.
gate.design_resolution: Questions 4-11 approved by the project owner on 2026-10-04.
gate.failure_policy: Reject SaURL if the independent adapter fails its pre-evaluation implementation or resource gate; do not substitute another method implicitly.
